title.zh: 瑞士FINMA批准该国首只面向零售投资者的现货比特币ETF
title.en: FINMA approves Switzerland's first spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors

current_state.zh: FINMA已于10月20日批准BIT Asset Management的BBIT现货比特币ETF，预计11月在SIX Swiss Exchange开始交易但具体日期未定；公开发行仍仅限瑞士，海外银行及券商可通过获批或现有交易参与者接入；其他加密资产ETF不会因该批准自动获批。
current_state.en: FINMA approved BIT Asset Management's BBIT spot Bitcoin ETF on Oct. 20; it is expected to begin trading on SIX Swiss Exchange in November but the exact date is undetermined. Public offering remains restricted to Switzerland, while overseas banks and brokers can access it via approved or existing trading participants; other crypto-asset ETFs are not automatically approved by this decision.

updates.title_zh: 瑞士FINMA批准该国首只面向零售投资者的现货比特币ETF
updates.title_en: 瑞士FINMA批准该国首只面向零售投资者的现货比特币ETF
updates.what_changed_zh: 瑞士FINMA批准该国首只面向散户投资者的现货比特币ETF，采用受监管的投资基金结构，在托管、运营风险和披露方面要求更严格，而非现有瑞士比特币ETP所使用的债务证券形式。
updates.what_changed_en: Switzerland's FINMA approved the country's first spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors, using a regulated investment-fund structure with stricter custody, operational-risk and disclosure requirements instead of the debt-security format used by existing Swiss Bitcoin ETPs.

updates.title_zh: 瑞士批准首只面向散户投资者的现货比特币ETF
updates.title_en: Switzerland approves first spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors
updates.what_changed_zh: 获批产品被明确为BIT Asset Management的Bitcoin Fund ETF（BBIT），预计11月在SIX Swiss Exchange开始交易，公开发行仅限瑞士。
updates.what_changed_en: The approved product was identified as BIT Asset Management's Bitcoin Fund ETF (BBIT), expected to begin trading on SIX Swiss Exchange in November, with public offering restricted to Switzerland.
updates.current_state_zh: FINMA已批准瑞士首只面向零售投资者的瑞士法下现货比特币ETF，即BIT Asset Management的BBIT，预计11月在SIX Swiss Exchange开始交易，公开发行仅限瑞士；其他基金提供商也已提交比特币ETF申请。
updates.current_state_en: FINMA has approved Switzerland's first Swiss-law spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors, BIT Asset Management's BBIT, expected to begin trading on SIX Swiss Exchange in November with public offering restricted to Switzerland; other fund providers have also submitted Bitcoin ETF applications.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Switzerland's FINMA approved BIT Asset Management's Bitcoin Fund ETF (BBIT), the country's first Swiss-law spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors, with trading on the SIX Swiss Exchange expected to start in November and the public offering limited to Switzerland.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Switzerland's FINMA approved BIT Asset Management's Bitcoin Fund ETF (BBIT), the country's first Swiss-law spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors, with trading on the SIX Swiss Exchange expected to start in November and the public offering limited to Switzerland.

updates.title_zh: 【瑞士首只现货比特币 ETF「BBIT」预计 11 月上市，将向海外银行及券商开放】
updates.title_en: 【瑞士首只现货比特币 ETF「BBIT」预计 11 月上市，将向海外银行及券商开放】
updates.what_changed_zh: SIX表示BBIT预计11月开始交易但具体日期尚未确定；海外银行及券商可通过获批交易参与者直接接入或经现有交易参与者间接交易，不过该基金仍仅获准在瑞士公开销售；FINMA还表示该批准不意味着以太坊、Solana等其他加密资产ETF可自动获批。
updates.what_changed_en: SIX said BBIT is expected to begin trading in November but the exact date is not yet determined; overseas banks and brokers can access it directly by becoming approved trading participants or indirectly via existing participants, while public sales remain restricted to Switzerland; FINMA also said the approval does not mean Ethereum, Solana or other crypto-asset ETFs will be automatically approved.
updates.current_state_zh: FINMA已于10月20日批准BIT Asset Management的BBIT现货比特币ETF，预计11月在SIX Swiss Exchange开始交易但具体日期未定；公开发行仍仅限瑞士，海外银行及券商可通过获批或现有交易参与者接入；其他加密资产ETF不会因该批准自动获批。
updates.current_state_en: FINMA approved BIT Asset Management's BBIT spot Bitcoin ETF on Oct. 20; it is expected to begin trading on SIX Swiss Exchange in November but the exact date is undetermined. Public offering remains restricted to Switzerland, while overseas banks and brokers can access it via approved or existing trading participants; other crypto-asset ETFs are not automatically approved by this decision.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Switzerland's first spot bitcoin ETF (BBIT) is set to begin trading on SIX in November, with overseas banks and brokers able to access it via approved or existing trading participants, though public sales remain restricted to Switzerland.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Switzerland's first spot bitcoin ETF (BBIT) is set to begin trading on SIX in November, with overseas banks and brokers able to access it via approved or existing trading participants, though public sales remain restricted to Switzerland.
